answers.solution:
Diagnosed and verified. Full solution written to:

**`~/orphaned-wave-harvest-<project>-solution.md`**

## Summary

The incident is **three stacked independent failures**, not one:

| # | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| RC-1 | `worktree.sh new` leaks the worktree dir when a dispatch dies; `git worktree prune` won't reap a *live* dir, only a vanished one | `git worktree remove --force` each dead worktree, then `prune`; branch refs survive |
| RC-2 | Foreman crashed between worker commit and merge; no durable pending-merge record | Re-harvest the ahead-1 `wt/*` branches, AO-judge per row, serial merge |
| RC-3 | gitreins tier-2 judge completes then zero-CPU loops ~40 min (GITR-JUDGE-001) | Watchdog kills it; `task complete --force --skip-tier2` since real gates already PASS |
| RC-4 | bunker3 `origin` is https with no token | Push only from the primary (local origin) |

Also captured a subtle gotcha: `git worktree add -b <branch> <existing-path>` creates the branch ref **before** failing on the path check, so a retry leaves a stray `*-retry` branch that the reaper must delete.

## Verification performed (not just asserted)

I reproduced the exact state in a sandbox — bare origin, primary, three worktrees each ahead 1 — then executed the runbook:

- Reproduced `fatal: '<path>' already exists`
- Confirmed `git worktree prune` alone leaves live dirs
- Confirmed reap preserves all three `wt/*` refs, and the path is reusable (`REAP_VERIFIED`)
- Confirmed all rows become ancestors of `origin/master`, content landed, `PUSH_VERIFIED`
- Built and tested the zero-CPU hang watchdog against a fake stuck judge → `WATCHDOG_KILL_VERIFIED`
- Ran the one-shot recovery script twice → idempotent, skips merged rows, `PUSH_VERIFIED`

The doc includes the exact phase-by-phase commands, the watchdog script, a self-contained one-shot recovery script, acceptance checks, and hardening recommendations (idempotent worktree acquisition, startup reaper, durable pending-merge state, always-push pending refs, watchdog every tier-2, push-from-primary).

signatures.description: Three independent worker dispatches (GAP-110, DOCS-GAP-006, DF-WARPFS-96) all committed their fixes to worktrees but died before the foreman could merge — discovered this tick as orphaned branches ahead of origin/master. Recovery: per-row AO judging against each row's criteria (live divergence checks, AO gate on bunker3, real-repo E2E, docs-only verification), serial bunker3 merge of disjoint crates, a do-cascade merge for the docs one (merge commit cc47cd8 triggers nothing), all from push origin on the primary (bunker3 has https origin = no https token; push must be local). gitreins tier-2 judge can HANG post-completion (known GITR-JUDGE-001-style: zero-CPU loop with context compaction warnings; complete stuck 40m) — recovery is kill + task complete --force --skip-tier2 with REAL gates already proven from the working tree. Verdicts saved 974873f4/75b7a6f8/d1ac713d all PASS.
